qualification: Isolated changes on the committed baseline; broader pending main-tree work excluded and preserved.
build_profile: release, correctness only; no speed/RSS claim

representation.json_namespace: Root and foreign namespaces derive their method table from the same intrinsic installer. Native methods carry their creation realm.
representation.allocation: JSON holders, parsed objects/arrays and reviver contexts derive prototypes from existing realm intrinsic records, never guest global constructor properties.
representation.native_functions: All native function allocations use the shared realm_function_prototype projection, matching ordinary function ownership. No additional realm state or callback map.
representation.errors: Foreign Error.prototype derives from its Object prototype, owns its Error.toString method, and is the parent of its TypeError prototype. TypeError constructors inherit their own Error constructor; they no longer expose caller-realm ancestry.

affected_test262.selection: JSON, staged JSON, Error and NativeErrors stages, plus only paths containing realm across official stages. The realm filter is a bounded affected subset, not a complete stage run.

node_controls.scope: Namespace/method identity and prototypes, parsed objects/arrays, reviver holders/contexts, syntax/type errors, raw JSON brand, abrupt identity, caller realm restoration, callback errors, tampered globals and Error/TypeError ancestry.
node_controls.input_policy: Independent ignored qualification inputs use Node-computed expected values and the existing Test262 embedding/harness. Empty directory structure satisfies stage-catalog validation; no pinned suite case, helper, exclusion or expectation changed. These are Node oracle controls, not additions to pinned conformance coverage.

internal_checks.gc_control: The fourteenth control retains an extracted foreign JSON.parse after discarding its global reference, then collects before parsing and in every reviver callback. Parsed/context prototypes retain the creation realm.
internal_checks.scope: Realm intrinsic error roots under stack failure/collection, scoped/promoted/foreign roots, typed errors, native construction, captured data and guest re-entry.

limits: No new Rust unit tests duplicating conformance fixtures. Existing internal lifecycle checks are reused.
The selected JSON staging family now passes 39/39, but complete current Test262, Wasm and implemented Node gates remain open. Stage A is not complete.
